name: twinseat
description: SharedWingsX shared flight deck, BluNova Virtual Airlines
author: BluNova Virtual Airlines

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @twinseat/protocol && concurrently -n relay,bridge,app -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @twinseat/relay" "npm run dev -w @twinseat/bridge" "npm run dev -w @twinseat/app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @twinseat/protocol && npm run build -w @twinseat/relay && npm run build -w @twinseat/bridge && npm run build -w @twinseat/app
scripts.test: npm run test -w @twinseat/protocol && npm run test -w @twinseat/bridge
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w @twinseat/protocol && npm run desktop -w @twinseat/app
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/write-logo-png.mjs && node scripts/write-ico.mjs && node scripts/build-wasm.mjs && node scripts/write-community-thumb.mjs && npm run build -w @twinseat/protocol && npm run dist:win -w @twinseat/app && node scripts/electron-builder-linux.mjs && node scripts/copy-download.mjs && npm run build -w @twinseat/web && node scripts/publish-web.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/write-logo-png.mjs && node scripts/write-ico.mjs && npm run build -w @twinseat/protocol && npm run dist:linux -w @twinseat/app && node scripts/copy-download.mjs
scripts.site: npm run site:prepare && npm run dev -w @twinseat/web
scripts.site:build: npm run site:prepare && npm run build -w @twinseat/web
